mapper.select: SELECT u.id, IFNULL(u.username, 'anonymous') AS username, DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_day, d.status_col, MIN(d.amount_col) AS amount_col FROM demo_entity u LEFT JOIN demo_order_detail d ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO demo_entity (id, username, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE demo_entity u INNER JOIN demo_profile p ON u.id = p.user_id SET u.username = p.display_name WHERE u.deleted = 0
mapper.delete: UPDATE demo_entity SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
